title: Calypso Configuration and Environment Management
description:
Project Description:

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Calypso practice.

We are a top-tier Calypso Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration.

We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered Calypso projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.


Project Description:

Support and additional build out for a greenfield Calypso instance.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop necessary technical solutions for Calypso environments and instance on the cloud as per requirements
  • Resolve Calypso environment related issues
  • Stabilize Calypso environment with improvements and other services architectural changes
  • Establish a comprehensive and integrated approach to defining, setting up, or trouble shooting issues arising from day-to-day activities on greenfield Calypso instance
  • Create and deliver assigned projects / tasks and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements
  • Competent in managing and establishing methodology and best practice for Calypso technical requirements
  • Ensures supporting documents are complete, current, and appropriately stored
  • Works closely with relevant business and technology stakeholders to ensure effective and efficient implementation of the project(s)
  • Submits status reports to stakeholders; coordinates and provides updates to steering committees
  • Collaboration with key functional or business stakeholders to achieve clear outcomes/deliverables in relation to the strategic and transformational book of work
  • Manage deliverables ensuring transparency of risks, issues and dependencies that are fully aligned to functional / business owners


You might be acting also as a business analyst as well in order to help the team gathering and writing requirements, acceptance criteria.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years of experience working in Capital Markets and Calypso
  • Environment management, support, and optimization experience on Calypso
  • • Good knowledge of Financial products cross assets
  • • Proven track record of delivery of implementation / migration projects
  • • Proven experience in the development of Calypso integrations, reporting, and other technical aspects
  • Experience of adherence to governance frameworks / implementation and handover to BAU
  • • Comprehensive knowledge of trade flow, trading systems and related concepts and technology, including valuation and client/market risk management
  • • Leadership skills
  • • Excellent analytical skills, understanding of project life cycles, and ability to act in an entrepreneurial manner to ensure the requirements from the business are gathered in the appropriate manner.
  • • Proven analytical, planning, problem solving and decision-making skills
  • • Comfortable with direct communication with all levels of technical and business resources
  • • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • • Experience with working in a highly collaborative and dynamic multi-team environment


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment is essential.
  • Have a willingness to learn new skills
  • Must have attention to detail
  • Must have the ability to work independently and also as part of a group


  • Experience of Agile practices and processes (e.g. SCRUM, KANBAN)
  • Any technical knowledge (Writing simple sql query, be able to read code )
  • Conflict management ensuring collaborative outcomes
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate
  • Spanish: C2 Proficient

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
Location / Remote: Remote -- Candidates who reside outside the United States will be considered.


Time Zone: Must be willing to work Eastern Timezone Hours


Communication : Only candidates with professional-level English proficiency will be considered.


Employment Type: 12-month contract (W-2, C2C).


Compensation: Up to 33 U.S. dollars per hour (depending on experience).


This role focuses on designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI-driven automation solutions. The Agentic Solutions Architect will play a hands-on role in architecting secure, scalable, and production-ready intelligent automation systems that integrate AI agents, enterprise platforms, APIs, and data systems. Success in this position requires deep technical expertise, a strong understanding of automation architecture, and the ability to guide teams in implementing innovative AI solutions.


Responsibilities:


  • Architect enterprise-grade intelligent automation solutions integrating AI agents, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
  • Design and implement multi-step workflows involving AI agents, RPA bots, and enterprise applications.
  • Establish architecture patterns for orchestration, exception handling, approvals, and auditability.
  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot and Power Platform AI tools, including Copilot Studio and Power Automate.
  • Architect secure integrations between AI agents, automation platforms, and enterprise data systems, particularly Databricks.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams.
  • Evaluate emerging agent technologies and recommend best practices for adoption.
  • Develop repeatable architecture standards, patterns, and governance practices for AI automation.


Required Skills:


  • 7+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise automation architecture, or similar roles.
  • Proven experience delivering AI-driven or intelligent automation solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Copilot / Power Platform AI capabilities (e.g., Copilot Studio, Power Automate).
  • Familiarity with Azure AI services or Microsoft AI Foundry.
  • Strong experience designing API-driven integrations and distributed automation architectures.
  • Experience integrating automation solutions with enterprise data platforms, with a preference for Databricks.
  • Ability to design secure, scalable, and production-ready AI automation solutions.


Preferred Skills:


  • Experience with enterprise RPA platforms such as UiPath or similar.
  • Experience designing multi-agent workflows or human-in-the-loop automation systems.
  • Experience supporting enterprise Automation or AI Centers of Excellence.
  • Expertise in establishing architecture standards, reusable components, and automation governance frameworks.

title: Director of Marketing | Hotel Technology Experience Required
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next-generation, AI-native platform for the hospitality industry. Looking for a Director of Marketing who understands hotels, understands technology, and knows how to turn that knowledge into real growth.


This role is ideal for someone who has marketed to hotel decision-makers before and enjoys building campaigns, writing compelling content, and generating measurable demand.


About the Role

We’re building something special for the hotel industry, and we’re looking for a Director of Marketing who feels at home in the world of hotel technology.


If you’ve spent meaningful time marketing to hoteliers, understand how hotel decision-makers think, and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to create campaigns that drive pipeline, you’ll thrive in this role.


This is a hands-on, full-funnel leadership role responsible for building and scaling our marketing engine. You will oversee demand generation, product marketing, content creation, and go-to-market strategy while working closely with Sales to drive qualified leads and revenue growth.


The hospitality industry values clarity, trust, and solutions that make operations easier. We’re looking for someone who knows how to communicate exactly that.


What You’ll Be Doing

Develop a deep understanding of the hotel ecosystem, including independent hotels, management companies, and brand-affiliated properties.


Stay closely connected to the needs and priorities of hotel decision-makers such as:

  • General Managers
  • Directors of Sales and Marketing
  • Revenue Managers
  • Digital marketing leaders
  • IT leaders


Use these insights to shape messaging, positioning, and campaigns that resonate with hotel operators.


Owning the Marketing Engine

Build and manage the full marketing funnel—from awareness through lead generation, nurturing, and conversion to sales.


Key areas include:

  • Demand generation strategy
  • SEO and digital acquisition
  • Email and lifecycle marketing
  • Webinars and industry events
  • Campaign development and execution


Your goal is to ensure marketing consistently generates qualified pipeline for the sales team.


Leading Blog and Thought Leadership Strategy

Own and grow the company’s blog and thought leadership presence to establish authority in the hospitality technology space and drive inbound demand.


This includes:

  • Writing and overseeing blog content focused on hotel industry trends and insights
  • Creating thought leadership around topics like AI in hospitality, guest engagement, and direct booking strategies
  • Developing SEO-driven blog content that attracts hotel decision-makers researching solutions
  • Implement AI Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to ensure the company and its content are discoverable through AI agents like Copilot, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging AI-driven discovery platforms.
  • Repurposing blog content into campaigns, LinkedIn posts, webinars, and sales materials


Creating Content That Speaks the Hotel Industry’s Language

Develop and oversee content that resonates with hospitality leaders, including:

  • Blog articles and thought leadership pieces
  • Industry guides and educational resources
  • Case studies and ROI stories
  • Campaign messaging and landing pages
  • Sales enablement materials


The goal is content that feels authentic, practical, and directly relevant to hotel operators , while positioning the company as a trusted voice in hospitality technology.


Becoming Deeply Fluent in the Product

You will develop strong product knowledge and become fluent in how the platform works.


This includes understanding:

  • How the product integrates into the hotel technology stack
  • The operational problems it solves for hotel teams
  • The value it creates for revenue growth and guest engagement


This fluency will help shape messaging, positioning, and product launches.


Partnering Closely with Sales

Marketing and sales alignment is critical in this role.


You will work closely with the sales team to:

  • Align on pipeline and growth targets
  • Develop campaigns that generate qualified opportunities
  • Support sales with content, messaging, and materials
  • Continuously improve lead quality and funnel performance


Using Data to Drive Decisions

Track performance across the funnel and continuously improve marketing efficiency.


You will analyze:

  • Lead generation performance
  • Campaign ROI
  • Funnel conversion metrics
  • Customer acquisition trends


Marketing should be measurable, predictable, and scalable.


Success in This Role

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to build a scalable marketing engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline.


Key outcomes include:

  • Growth in marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline
  • Consistent generation of qualified leads for the sales team
  • Increased inbound demand through SEO, blog content, and thought leadership
  • Strong campaign performance across webinars, events, and digital channels
  • Clear and compelling positioning that resonates with hotel decision-makers


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience marketing to hotels or within the hospitality technology ecosystem
  • Experience in B2B SaaS marketing and demand generation
  • Proven ability to generate qualified pipeline and measurable revenue impact
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, including blogs and thought leadership content
  • Ability to translate complex technology into clear, compelling messaging
  • Comfort operating both strategically and hands-on
  • Experience collaborating closely with sales teams in a pipeline-driven environment
  • Interest in AI-driven platforms, automation, and emerging technology transforming hospitality


Experience at or working with hospitality technology platforms such as hotel CRM, guest engagement, marketing automation, revenue management, or hotel operations platforms is highly valued.


Why You Might Love This Role

You enjoy understanding how an industry works and building marketing that speaks directly to it.

title: SAP Specialist
description:
SAP S/4HANA FICO AMS Consultant

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 production support for SAP S/4HANA Finance (FICO) modules.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets using ITSM tools such as ServiceNow.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent solutions for recurring system issues.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial closing activities with finance teams.
  • Handle critical finance incidents and communicate updates to business and IT stakeholders.
  • Support and troubleshoot SAP FI modules including:
  • General Ledger (FI-GL)
  • Accounts Payable (FI-AP)
  • Accounts Receivable (FI-AR)
  • Asset Accounting (FI-AA)
  • Bank Accounting and Electronic Bank Statements
  • Provide support for Controlling (CO) processes during closing cycles including:
  • Material Ledger
  • Cost Center Accounting
  • Profit Center Accounting
  • Allocations and settlements
  • Analyze integration issues between finance and logistics processes such as FI-MM and FI-SD integrations.
  • Deliver minor system enhancements and configuration updates within the AMS support scope.
  • Prepare functional documentation, test cases, and support user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Participate in change management and release processes.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation aligned with audit and compliance standards.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 7–10 years of experience in SAP FICO consulting or application support.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance modules.

title: Consultor SAP IDM 8.0 (Identity Management) | Projeto Remoto
description:
A Verus Brasil, especializada em soluções SAP e TI, está com oportunidade em aberto para:


Consultor SAP IDM 8.0 (Identity Management) | Projeto Remoto


⌛ Período: aproximadamente 1,5 mês de esforço, podendo ser prorrogado

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Início previsto: Abril/2026

⏱️ Formato de atuação: sob demanda (não exige dedicação exclusiva)


Contexto do Projeto


Trata-se de uma alocação pontual em projeto já em andamento, voltada à adequação técnica e atualização do ambiente SAP Identity Management (SAP IDM 8.0).

Embora o cronograma geral do projeto se estenda até outubro de 2026, a atuação deste recurso estará concentrada nas atividades iniciais relacionadas ao IDM, com maior intensidade entre abril e maio de 2026.

O consultor deverá ter disponibilidade compatível com o cronograma, especialmente nas fases críticas de execução, validação e acompanhamento pós go-live.


Responsabilidades


Conduzir atividades de upgrade e adequação técnica do SAP IDM 8.0

Garantir compatibilidade do ambiente com SAP S/4HANA e SAP GRC

Preservar as configurações existentes e estabilidade do ambiente

Realizar validações técnicas e funcionais após atualização de Support Packages

Executar testes técnicos e validação de fluxos de identidade e provisionamento

Atuar no troubleshooting avançado de jobs, workflows e logs do ambiente

Suportar as etapas iniciais de homologação e estabilização


Requisitos Técnicos


Experiência comprovada em:

SAP Identity Management – SAP IDM 8.0

Validação funcional de Support Packages do SAP IDM

Arquitetura do ambiente IDM:

Identity Center

Runtime

Job Server

Dispatcher

Provisioning Framework

Configuração e manutenção de Tasks, Workflows e Scripts (JavaScript no IDM)

Virtual Directory Server (VDS)

Integração com ambientes SAP S/4HANA e SAP GRC

Troubleshooting avançado de jobs e logs do ambiente

Desejável conhecimento em banco de dados:

MS SQL

Oracle

Sybase ASE


⏱️ Disponibilidade


As atividades não precisam ocorrer integralmente em horário comercial, sendo possível executar parte das tarefas em horários alternativos.

No entanto, será necessário participar de reuniões de alinhamento e checkpoints com o cliente em horário comercial, especialmente no início do projeto e nos marcos críticos de execução.

title: SAP S/4 HANA BRIM Application Expert (Experto en aplicaciones SAP S/4 HANA BRIM)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE

Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.


KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
  • Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
  • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

  • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
  • Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
  • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

description:

title: Brand Intern - Portuguese
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018.
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide.
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC.
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified.
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs.
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs.
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems.
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko.
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023.
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users.

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.

BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Internship| Long-term | REMOTE

Key Responsibilities

  • Support regional brand and marketing campaigns, including planning, coordination, and execution
  • Assist in brand content creation and localization, such as social media posts, blogs, PR materials, and campaign assets
  • Participate in social media planning, including content ideas, posting calendars, campaign themes, and basic execution support
  • Help track and organize campaign performance and brand metrics (e.g. media coverage, social performance, basic analytics)
  • Maintain and update brand assets and content libraries
  • Conduct market and competitor research to support brand strategy and regional insights
  • Provide general support for cross-team collaboration and communication


Requirements

  • Undergraduate or graduate student majoring in Marketing, Communications or related field
  • Strong interest in branding, marketing, and global communications
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English (additional languages are needed)
  • Familiar with social media platforms (X/Twitter, Instagram, Youtube, TikTok, etc.)
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple tasks
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-cultural environment
  • Basic knowledge of Web3 / crypto / fintech is a plus, but not required



Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA com foco em garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções desenvolvidas pela Klavi. Essa pessoa atuará de forma colaborativa com os times de produto e engenharia, contribuindo para a definição de cenários de teste, automação de testes, identificação e prevenção de bugs em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.


Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.


Salário

  • Regime: PJ
  • Salário: Competitivo
  • Nível: Especialista


Principais responsabilidades

  • Investigar e diagnosticar falhas, identificando a causa raiz de bugs e inconsistências no sistema.
  • Criar suítes de testes com base nos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais das features.
  • Implementar testes automatizados para garantir a cobertura e a confiabilidade de novas funcionalidades.
  • Validar o estado do sistema antes de implantações, garantindo que todos os ambientes estejam estáveis e prontos para release.
  • Ter um entendimento profundo dos fluxos atuais do sistema para antecipar riscos e propor melhorias de qualidade.
  • Monitorar continuamente a saúde e o desempenho das aplicações, atuando preventivamente em casos de instabilidade.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Inglês avançado – Será necessário para se comunicar com times internacionais, participar de reuniões técnicas e colaborar em projetos globais.
  • Formação acadêmica na área de computação – Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com os testes automatizados
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial – Atuação no escritório da Klavi em São Paulo, em modelo híbrido ou presencial, conforme combinado.
  • Tech Stack: Python, Java, Golang, AWS (EKS, SQS, SNS), PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Git, Jenkins, Grafana


Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash benefícios: Vale Refeição, Alimentação e Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental estendida: a licença maternidade é de 6 meses e a licença parental é de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Incentivo a educação;
  • Gympass;
  • Day Off aniversário;
  • Chat GPT Pro;
  • Bônus.

Salário

description:
Localização: Remoto

Tipo de contratação: Tempo integral

Contrato: A combinar


Descrição da vaga

Estamos procurando um(a) Senior Account Manager para gerenciar relacionamentos com clientes e apoiar a coordenação de projetos de marketing e publicidade. Este profissional atuará como ponto de contato entre clientes e equipes internas, garantindo que as iniciativas sejam organizadas e executadas de forma eficiente.


Responsabilidades

Gerenciar e manter relacionamento com contas de clientes.

Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre clientes e equipes internas.

Compreender os objetivos dos clientes e apoiar a implementação de iniciativas de marketing.

Acompanhar o progresso de projetos e campanhas.

Monitorar resultados e preparar relatórios de desempenho quando necessário.

Colaborar com equipes de marketing, mídia e criação para garantir a execução das campanhas.


Requisitos

Experiência em gestão de contas, marketing, publicidade ou áreas relacionadas.

Boas habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento profissional.

Capacidade de organizar e acompanhar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados.

Capacidade de trabalhar em colaboração com diferentes equipes.


Benefícios

Remuneração compatível com o mercado.

Ambiente de trabalho profissional e colaborativo.

Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
A US Academy of Esthetics é uma empresa de transição de vida profissional focada no direcionamento e certificação de profissionais da saúde (médicos e dentistas) por meio de programas premium com padrão americano para atuação na Harmonização Orofacial e Corporal.

Objetivo:

Estamos buscando um parceiro de marketing para:

  • Gerar leads qualificados (médicos e dentistas)
  • Vender programas de certificação high ticket
  • Construir autoridade internacional e posicionamento premium da marca

Escopo da oportunidade:

Esperamos suporte nas seguintes áreas:

  • Estratégia de funil (preferencialmente perpétuo)
  • Gestão de tráfego pago (Meta, Google e YouTube)
  • Copywriting (nível high ticket)
  • Estratégia de conteúdo (foco em autoridade, não apenas postagem)
  • Produção de conteúdo (diferencial, mas não obrigatório)

O que NÃO buscamos:

  • Estratégias voltadas para captação de pacientes
  • Gestão genérica de redes sociais
  • Foco em engajamento superficial (likes, seguidores, etc.)

O que esperamos:

  • Experiência comprovada com produtos high ticket
  • Experiência com educação, mentorias ou certificações
  • Domínio de funis de vendas e conversão
  • Abordagem orientada a dados (CAC, ROAS, LTV)
  • Proficiência em Inglês para se comunicar com nosso CEO

KPIs:

  • Custo por lead qualificado
  • Taxa de conversão
  • Custo de aquisição de cliente (CAC)
  • Retorno sobre investimento em mídia (ROAS)

Perguntas a responder na sua aplicação:

  • Quais produtos high ticket vocês já venderam?
  • Vocês trabalham com funil perpétuo ou lançamentos?
  • Quem é responsável pelo copywriting?
  • Quais canais de tráfego vocês operam?
  • Podem compartilhar cases com resultados mensuráveis?

NOTA DE POSICIONAMENTO:

Nosso posicionamento está mais próximo de:

Educação internacional premium (estilo Ivy League)

E NÃO de:

  • Marketing para clínicas ou captação de pacientes



REMUNERAÇÃO:

R$ 5.000,00 por mês

description:
A US Academy of Esthetics é uma empresa de transição de vida profissional focada no direcionamento e certificação de profissionais da saúde (médicos e dentistas) por meio de programas premium com padrão americano para atuação na Harmonização Orofacial e Corporal.

Objetivo:

Estamos buscando um parceiro de marketing para:

  • Gerar leads qualificados (médicos e dentistas)
  • Vender programas de certificação high ticket
  • Construir autoridade internacional e posicionamento premium da marca

Escopo da oportunidade:

Esperamos suporte nas seguintes áreas:

  • Estratégia de funil (preferencialmente perpétuo)
  • Gestão de tráfego pago (Meta, Google e YouTube)
  • Copywriting (nível high ticket)
  • Estratégia de conteúdo (foco em autoridade, não apenas postagem)
  • Produção de conteúdo (diferencial, mas não obrigatório)

O que NÃO buscamos:

  • Estratégias voltadas para captação de pacientes
  • Gestão genérica de redes sociais
  • Foco em engajamento superficial (likes, seguidores, etc.)

O que esperamos:

  • Experiência comprovada com produtos high ticket
  • Experiência com educação, mentorias ou certificações
  • Domínio de funis de vendas e conversão
  • Abordagem orientada a dados (CAC, ROAS, LTV)
  • Proficiência em Inglês para se comunicar com nosso CEO

KPIs:

  • Custo por lead qualificado
  • Taxa de conversão
  • Custo de aquisição de cliente (CAC)
  • Retorno sobre investimento em mídia (ROAS)

Perguntas a responder na sua aplicação:

  • Quais produtos high ticket vocês já venderam?
  • Vocês trabalham com funil perpétuo ou lançamentos?
  • Quem é responsável pelo copywriting?
  • Quais canais de tráfego vocês operam?
  • Podem compartilhar cases com resultados mensuráveis?

NOTA DE POSICIONAMENTO:

Nosso posicionamento está mais próximo de:

Educação internacional premium (estilo Ivy League)

E NÃO de:

  • Marketing para clínicas ou captação de pacientes



REMUNERAÇÃO:

R$ 5.000,00 por mês

title: Marketing & Website Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Job Title: Marketing & Website Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)

Company : Elevated Tahoe Properties

Location : Remote


About Us

Elevated Tahoe Properties manages high-touch short-term rental and property portfolios focused on guest experience, operational excellence, and high-performing marketing that drives direct bookings. We’re hiring a proactive, creative, and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our website, digital marketing, social media, and lead generation efforts.

Our Company Culture:

  • We are a fun, young company growing quickly
  • We value open communication and adding in humor whenever possible
  • Our team is self driven and empowered to handle their own responsibilities without being micromanaged
  • We inspire each other to become the best version of ourselves we can possibly become. 
  • We lead by example and use positive reinforcement to inspire others to strive for personal and professional greatness.

Role Summary

You will be responsible for helping us grow our online presence and increase direct vacation rental bookings through website updates, landing page creation, lead capture strategy, email marketing, and social media content support. This role requires strong design instincts, attention to detail, marketing experience, and a solid understanding of WordPress, Elementor, and basic website coding.


Key Responsibilities


  • Manage and update our WordPress website using Elementor
  • Build and optimize landing pages designed to drive bookings and capture leads
  • Improve website layout, visuals, and user experience to support conversion goals
  • Help increase traffic to the website through organic and campaign-based marketing efforts
  • Develop compelling, conversion-focused copywriting that incorporates SEO best practices for all web and marketing assets
  • Edit and prepare social media content including short-form video, photos, graphics, and captions
  • Schedule and publish social media posts across relevant platforms
  • Monitor inbound leads and help organize follow-up and lead nurturing workflows
  • Create and manage nurture email campaigns for existing guests, past guests, and new leads
  • Support list building, audience segmentation, and email campaign improvements
  • Assist with marketing asset creation for promotions, campaigns, and seasonal offers
  • Maintain brand consistency across website pages, email marketing, and social media content
  • Collaborate with leadership on ideas to improve direct bookings, lead generation, and guest engagement

Qualifications


  • Proven experience in digital marketing, website management, or lead generation
  • Strong hands-on experience with WordPress and Elementor
  • Strong design skills with an eye for clean, polished, high-converting content
  • Experience editing social media video and photo content
  • Experience with email marketing platforms and nurture campaigns
  • Comfortable creating landing pages and understanding basic conversion strategy
  • Decent to strong website coding basics, including familiarity with HTML/CSS and light troubleshooting
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple moving pieces
  • Able to work independently, take initiative, and bring creative solutions to the table
  • Familiarity with Asana or similar project management tools

Non‑Negotiable Requirements

  • Reliable backup power (UPS or generator) to prevent downtime during outages
  • Dual monitors for efficient multitasking
  • Backup internet (secondary wired connection or mobile hotspot) with stable speeds
  • Quiet, dedicated workspace and dependable computer 

Preferred

  • Experience with the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) or similar creative tools
  • Strong video editing proficiency for creating engaging short-form content
  • Deep understanding of social media marketing trends, algorithms, and best practices
  • Experience working with hospitality, vacation rentals, real estate, or travel brands

Required Days/Hours

  • Monday - Friday 8AM to 5PM Pacific Time (1 hour unpaid Lunch Break)


Compensation Target:

$950 per month + monthly KPI bonus / 40 hours per week — salary negotiable based on experience.

What We Offer

  • Remote role supporting a growing vacation rental and hospitality brand
  • Opportunity to directly impact bookings, lead generation, and brand growth
  • Creative, collaborative team environment with room to contribute ideas and improve systems


How to Apply (only email applications will be considered)


Email :

Subject : The Marketing & Website Coordinator Your Team Needs


Include:

  • Your Resume/CV
  • ONE OF (listed in order of preference):
  • A link to your personal portfolio website
  • A comprehensive PDF format portfolio document
  • At list of at least 5 links of design and marketing work you’ve completed
  • Pre-Screening Form:
  • Internet Speed Verification:

Note : Please only submit a screenshot of the speed test results.

  • DISC Assessment:

  Note : Please only submit a screenshot of the DISC assessment results graph.

  • A 2–3 minute video that includes:

-Brief intro and summary of your experience

-Why you’re the ideal candidate for this position

-Your top 3 skills that make you an excellent marketing and design coordinator


﻿Only applicants who follow these instructions exactly and demonstrate strong attention to detail will be considered.


Thank you and we look forward to working with you!


~ Elevated Tahoe Properties Team

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: GESTOR DE FUNIL
description:
LINK DO FORMULÁRIO PARA CADASTRAR-SE PARA VAGA:

Clique aqui > TypeformFaça parte do nosso time!

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Estruturar, organizar e otimizar funis de vendas de Direct Response (Front-end, Upsell, Downsell, Cross-sell e Order Bump);
  • Analisar métricas de conversão (CVR, AOV, CPA, LTV, lucro por lead);
  • Atualizar e consolidar indicadores de performance financeira dos funis (DRE por produto, margem, CMV, comissões e reembolsos);
  • Apoiar na montagem de projeções de fluxo de caixa por oferta;
  • Cruzar dados de diferentes plataformas (checkout, CRM, gateways de pagamento, afiliados);
  • Analisar cenários de preço (A/B), impacto em AOV, lucro por lead e taxas de reembolso;
  • Identificar gargalos de conversão e propor testes estruturados;
  • Coordenar melhorias de funil junto às áreas de Copy, Video, Tech, Produto e Backend;
  • Organizar roadmap de projetos de funil e garantir entregas dentro do prazo;
  • Validar integrações entre checkout, CRM, e-mail, SMS e webhooks;
  • Apoiar na preparação de relatórios operacionais para diretoria (margem por produto, lucro por lead, eficiência de funil, performance de ofertas);
  • Participar ativamente da definição de prioridades estratégicas com base em dados.

QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Experiência sólida com funis de vendas
  • Excel / Google Sheets avançado – uso de fórmulas complexas para manipulação de grandes bases de dados;
  • Experiência com métricas de performance digital (AOV, CPA, CVR, LTV);
  • Experiência com demonstrativos financeiros aplicados a marketing (DRE por produto, margem de contribuição);
  • Experiência com modelagem de cenários para tomada de decisão;
  • Conhecimento de integrações entre plataformas (checkout, CRM, gateways);
  • Elevado grau de responsabilidade com dados, indicadores e impacto financeiro;
  • Perfil analítico ativo: capacidade de interpretar resultados e propor soluções estratégicas.
  • Conhecimento intermediário de HTML e lógica básica de JavaScript (edição de scripts, botões e redirecionamentos), configuração de webhooks e familiaridade com pixels, UTMs e validação de eventos.
  • Capacidade de debugar problemas de funil em produção (redirecionamentos, integrações e tracking), com autonomia para resolver falhas técnicas sem depender constantemente do time de TI.
  • Diferencial :
  • Experiência com mercado internacional e afiliados.
  • Se fluente em inglês.

COMPETÊNCIAS:

  • PROATIVIDADE
  • ANALÍTICO
  • FOCO EM RESULTADO
  • ORGANIZAÇÃO
  • CAPACIDADE DE PRIORIZAÇÃO
  • RESOLUTIVO
  • COMUNICAÇÃO CLARA

SALÁRIO:

  • A combinar
  • Bônus trimestral - Vale a partir do segundo Trimestre dentro da empresa.

TIPO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:

  • A prestação de serviço será feita no Regime PJ.
  • 100% Home Office

COMO FUNCIONA O TRABALHO:

  • Nossa comunicação é feita pelo discord, o candidato aprovado tem que estar disponível na plataforma para responder e se comunicar. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • Usamos o ClickUp para gerenciar as atividades da equipe. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • O candidato selecionado terá um período de três meses para ganhar experiência na empresa antes de ser efetivado na vaga

title: Business Development Manager - LatAm Focus
description:
The Mandate: Forging New Paths to Prosperity


We are seeking a full-time BDM with a proven client portfolio and the confidence to open entirely new markets for our portfolio.


✅ Key Responsibilities:


  • Strategic Client Acquisition: Proactively develop and secure new clients, with a sharp focus on expanding Fa Chai Gaming's presence and securing major deals across Central and South America.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategy: Submit regular, insightful reports on regional business developments and market trends, providing actionable recommendations to guide our strategic decision-making and product adaptation.
  • Ambassador & Host: Represent Fa Chai Gaming at key iGaming exhibitions and industry events, adeptly hosting clients and nurturing new business relationships face-to-face.
  • Relationship Nurturing: Undertake periodic business trips across the region to maintain and deepen strategic client relationships, ensuring high client satisfaction and sustained commercial growth.


What Brings You Fortune (Requirements & Skills)


  • Language Mastery: Demonstrated proficiency in both English and Portuguese (Spanish is a strong plus).
  • Industry Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional sales experience in the online gaming/iGaming B2B sector.
  • Existing Client Resources: Must possess an established and active network of operator contacts within the LatAm market, with a proven ability to convert leads into major commercial partnerships.
  • Industry Preference: Candidates with previous sales or business development experience working for established European or American gaming providers/platforms will be strongly preferred.
  • Market Expertise: A deep understanding of the regulatory landscape, operator needs, and player preferences within the Central and South American market is a strong advantage.
  • Location Advantage: A current base of operations within Brazil or a major LatAm market hub is highly desirable.


Are you ready to build a new empire for Fa Chai Gaming and take the lead in LatAm?


If you have the network, the drive, and the ambition to succeed in a fast-paced environment where growth is the ultimate metric, apply now.

title: Performance Marketing Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Paid Media Marketing Specialist to drive high-quality leads by creating, managing, and measuring Digital Marketing campaigns across Google, YouTube, social, and other relevant channels.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on, independent strategic thinker who brings deep expertise in running digital marketing programs and developing digital marketing assets (with our designer) within B2B SaaS organizations.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive, this isn’t the role for you. But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own:

  • Develop programs and strategies for customer acquisition, retention, and expansion through multiple channels, including search, PMAX, social, retargeting, content (written and video), and more.
  • Define KPIs and implement measurement, analytics, benchmarking, and reporting methods to gauge success for marketing channels, campaigns, and initiatives.
  • Drive continual improvements in lead conversion rates and revenue close rates.
  • Continue to scale our marketing efforts and take primary responsibility for exceeding our KPIs for each quarter.
  • Work closely with the overall Marketing team to define required assets such as content, images, video, etc.

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Se você gosta de atuar na interface entre negócio e tecnologia, facilitando rituais ágeis e garantindo a evolução contínua de processos e sistemas...

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas do Office 365

Diferencial

title: Auditor(a)
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Auditor(a) Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 30 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Auditor(a) . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Possuir graduação em Tecnologia da Informação ou graduação em qualquer área acompanhada de pós-graduação (especialização, mestrado ou doutorado) em TI, com carga horária mínima de 360 horas;
  • Ter experiência profissional comprovada na área de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Ter experiência profissional comprovada em auditoria de sistemas e plataformas;
  • Possuir certificação Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Dominar práticas ágeis, incluindo design incremental, design thinking, planning poker, refatoração, testes automatizados, BDD, TDD, DevOps, programação em par, inspeção e revisão de código, Definition of Ready (DoR) e Definition of Done (DoD), integração e entrega contínuas (CI/CD), propriedade coletiva do código, histórias de usuário, critérios de aceitação, linguagem Gherkin, PDCA, produtização, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) e Configuration as Code (CaC);
  • Conhecer frameworks e referenciais como Manifesto Ágil, Scrum, Kanban, Lean, XP, DevOps, SAFe®, SRE, ITIL, COBIT, AIOps, FinOps, CMMI, MPS.BR e SOx;
  • Ter experiência com nuvens Microsoft Azure e AWS
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Realizar auditorias proativas e regulares nas aplicações e nos times de desenvolvimento, com base nos requisitos de conformidade do cliente e nas melhores práticas esperadas no desenvolvimento na plataforma;
  • Cooperar com as áreas de conformidade, privacidade, segurança da informação e auditoria do cliente para elaborar planos de ação diante de riscos e não conformidades mapeadas;
  • Atualizar-se continuamente sobre regulamentações e normas relevantes relacionadas à conformidade e auditoria, garantindo que as aplicações e os times de desenvolvimento estejam em conformidade com requisitos legais e regulatórios;
  • Promover a conscientização e a capacitação dos times de desenvolvimento sobre práticas de conformidade e auditoria, fomentando a adoção de uma cultura de conformidade em todos os níveis da organização;
  • Atuar como ponto focal em resposta a auditorias internas ou externas, fornecendo suporte tanto no nível da plataforma quanto no das aplicações.


Nossos cuidados com você:

*Benefícios a variar de acordo com a modalidade de contrato

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
Senior Test Automation Engineer - Remote


As part of our Global Network Vision, we’re building a high-performant, programmable and highly predictable software-defined global fabric.


What you’ll be doing

  • Developing/Optimising a portable test framework to cover testing needs across the Network Topology.
  • Be Agile, Test Driven and a highly technical tester.
  • Collaborate with test and development engineers on application & testing architecture, to ensure that the approaches and technologies applied to the current implementation are sound and fit for purpose.
  • Understanding of programming principles and best practices.


Skills and Experience

  • Python automation
  • CI/CD
  • Robot or Pytest
  • Networking Knowledge across any of the following areas: IP protocols, Routes, L2/L3, Nornir, Netmiko, Netbox, Software Defined Networking knowledge

Skills and Experience

  • Python automation
  • CI/CD
  • Robot or Pytest

A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:

Analista BI - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Proficiência em SQL , com capacidade de realizar consultas complexas
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau ou similares)
  • Habilidade na criação de relatórios e dashboards gerenciais
  • Conhecimento em análise estatística e testes de hipóteses
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados em insights acionáveis para o negócio

title: AI Test Engineer Junior
description:
AI Test Engineer Junior — Voidr

Modelo: Full-time · Horário flexível

Local: Remoto (encontros presenciais em SP)


O que é a Voidr?

Startup de IA que automatiza testes de software para sistemas de missão crítica. Clientes como Stone, Ambev, Philips e Serasa. Investida por ONEVC, co-founder da Gupy, ex-CFO do Nubank, entre outros.

O que você vai fazer?


Pilotar AI Agents que testam sistemas enterprise de forma autônoma, usando Playwright como engine. Na prática: configurar agents, integrar em pipelines CI/CD, analisar resultados e refinar estratégias de teste.


O que precisa ter?


  • 1–2 anos com automação de testes ou dev
  • TypeScript + Node.js (básico a intermediário)
  • Playwright, Cypress ou Selenium
  • Interesse real em IA
  • Inglês fluente


Diferenciais


  • Ter experimentado com LLMs / Copilot / Claude
  • Experiência em sistemas de missão crítica (fintech, healthtech)
  • Projetos pessoais ou open source com automação/IA


Benefícios

  • Horário flexível
  • VR + VT
  • Plano de saúde premium
  • TotalPass
  • Budget educação
  • Stock options
  • Day off no aniversário


Processo seletivo

Aplicação → Triagem com IA → Desafio técnico → Apresentação para fundadores → Feedback → Oferta

title: Especialista em SAP S/4HANA e Inteligência Artificial
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Grupo Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 67.000 colaboradores e receita anual de aproximadamente €10 bilhões, atuando em 61 países sob duas marcas: Atos, voltada para serviços, e Eviden, focada em produtos.

Reconhecido como o número 1 na Europa em cibersegurança, computação em nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo Atos está comprometido com um futuro seguro e descarbonizado, oferecendo soluções completas e personalizadas, impulsionadas por inteligência artificial, para todos os setores.

O Grupo Atos é a marca sob a qual opera a Atos SE (Societas Europaea), empresa listada na Euronext Paris.

O propósito do Grupo Atos é ajudar a desenhar o futuro do espaço da informação. Sua expertise e serviços apoiam o desenvolvimento do conhecimento, da educação e da pesquisa com uma abordagem multicultural, contribuindo para o avanço da excelência científica e tecnológica.

Em todo o mundo, o Grupo capacita seus clientes, colaboradores e a sociedade em geral a viver, trabalhar e se desenvolver de forma sustentável, em um espaço de informação seguro e confiável.


Contratação CLT


Resumo da Posição

Buscamos um(a) Especialista em SAP S/4HANA com foco em Inteligência Artificial, responsável por desenhar, implementar e escalar soluções baseadas em IA que aumentem a produtividade, qualidade, previsibilidade e efetividade de projetos de implementação e conversão SAP S/4HANA.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Aplicar IA e automação inteligente em projetos SAP S/4HANA.

• Acelerar fases do SAP Activate.

• Automatizar testes e análise de riscos.

• Utilizar IA generativa para documentação, testes e troubleshooting.

• Trabalhar com SAP BTP, serviços de IA e integrações com LLMs.

• Definir métricas de produtividade e ROI.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Formação superior completa.

• Experiência sólida em SAP S/4HANA.

• Conhecimento em SAP Activate.

• Experiência em IA aplicada a SAP.

• Inglês avançado.


Desejáveis

• Certificação SAP Activate.

• Experiência com SAP BTP, RPA e IA Generativa.


Localização

Disponibilidade para eventuais viagens conforme projetos.


------


Benefícios:

✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

✓ Plano odontológico

✓ Programa de remuneração variável

✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade

✓ Wellhub (Gympass)

✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos

✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

✓ Seguro de vida

✓ Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)

✓ Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

✓ Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)

✓ Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

✓ Programa de treinamentos internos e externos

✓ Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

✓ Terapia online

✓ Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)

✓ Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro

✓ Day off no seu aniversário

✓ Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

✓ Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna)

✓ Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa)

title: Devops Java + AWS (Projeto Internacional)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com Java e que possui conhecimentos em AWS.
  • Experiência com CI/CD, (Kubernetes / Jenkins / Docker) será um diferencial.
  • Experiência com banco de dados;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Esse profissional será responsável por provisionar, configurar e manter ambientes em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas para garantir escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança dos sistemas.

O profissional também atuará no suporte operacional, realizando análises de erros e troubleshooting, assegurando que os ambientes estejam corretamente logados, monitorados e performando de forma eficiente. Ter conhecimento ou interesse em práticas de CI/CD é valorizado, assim como disposição para trabalhar com ferramentas correlatas.

O que oferecemos:

title: Paid PPC Performance Marketing Manager
description:
We are first and foremost a great team full of ambitious and proactive individuals whose goal is to

become the best professionals they can be and make Digital Silk a globally renowned digital agency.


We are seeking an expert level Paid PPC Performance Marketing Manager with proven hands-on expertise in:

  • Be hands-on in setting up paid marketing campaigns & strategies to generate results for a large portfolio of clients.
  • Lead advanced account builds and restructures (naming conventions, campaign architecture, match type strategy, query mining, audience layering, exclusions, asset strategy, Conversions API’s, ETL’s etc.).
  • Oversee & train marketing team members on building and optimizing campaigns
  • Creating effective marketing copy to generate engagement
  • Know how to responsibly and effectively use AI to streamline deliverables, create reports and enhance results.


Digital Silk is built upon the principles of self-betterment, excellence, proactivity, and teamwork. If you share our passion and values, and want to be challenged and thrive in your career, then you’ll fit right in.


Digital Silk offers yearly growth opportunities AND company shares for all team members.


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position as our headquarters are in the US. We do require team members to work 8am to 5pm EST (with breaks) as our clients are in the US.


Requirements & Responsibilities:

● Minimum 7 years of digital marketing experience

● Proven hands-on expertise in PPC/paid search (Google Ads is essential; Microsoft Ads strongly preferred).

● Lead and mentor a team of paid media specialists/managers - improve performance through coaching, audits, training, and SOPs.

● Ensure clean, reliable measurements: conversion setup and QA, GA4 alignment, GTM, UTM governance, and performance diagnostics.

● Experience in at least 2 additional programmatic channels (e.g., Paid Social, YouTube, Display/Programmatic, Shopping/Feeds, etc.).

● Establish high standards for quality, speed, documentation, and accountability.

● Help build scalable processes that improve client outcomes and internal efficiency. Translate business goals into measurable media plans, including channel mix, budget allocation, forecasting, and pacing.

● Drive continuous improvement through testing: ad copy/creative tests, landing page/CRO collaboration, audience experiments, bid strategy tests, and offer positioning.

● Proven expertise in creating effective marketing strategies and reports

● Proven ability to lead teams and improve marketing performance

● Effective time management skills. Ability to multitask and manage multiple teams and projects

● Strong marketing copywriting skills is CRITICAL

● Proven ability to manage teams and budgets

● Professional and proactive work ethic

● High competence in project and stakeholder management

● Excellent interpersonal, communication skills

● Able to work EST hours work 8am to 5pm EST (with breaks)


What we offer at Digital Silk:


● A work culture focused on mutual success and continuous growth

● Competitive pay, salary growth and bonuses

● Equity ownership in our company – share in profit upon company sale!

● Challenging projects and opportunity to work with great team members

● Work-from-home opportunity

● 4 weeks paid time off


We are a growing digital agency and are seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Recruitment steps:


· Apply via LinkedIn

· Receive short questionnaire

· Send back answers + CV

· Have a short intro call with our Recruitment Team

· Get introduced to our Hiring Managers

· Get feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

become the best professionals they can be and make Digital Silk a globally renowned digital agency.


We are seeking an expert level Paid PPC Performance Marketing Manager with proven hands-on expertise in:

  • Be hands-on in setting up paid marketing campaigns & strategies to generate results for a large portfolio of clients.
  • Lead advanced account builds and restructures (naming conventions, campaign architecture, match type strategy, query mining, audience layering, exclusions, asset strategy, Conversions API’s, ETL’s etc.).
  • Oversee & train marketing team members on building and optimizing campaigns
  • Creating effective marketing copy to generate engagement
  • Know how to responsibly and effectively use AI to streamline deliverables, create reports and enhance results.


Digital Silk is built upon the principles of self-betterment, excellence, proactivity, and teamwork. If you share our passion and values, and want to be challenged and thrive in your career, then you’ll fit right in.


Digital Silk offers yearly growth opportunities AND company shares for all team members.


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position as our headquarters are in the US. We do require team members to work 8am to 5pm EST (with breaks) as our clients are in the US.


Requirements & Responsibilities:

● Minimum 7 years of digital marketing experience

● Proven hands-on expertise in PPC/paid search (Google Ads is essential; Microsoft Ads strongly preferred).

● Lead and mentor a team of paid media specialists/managers - improve performance through coaching, audits, training, and SOPs.

● Ensure clean, reliable measurements: conversion setup and QA, GA4 alignment, GTM, UTM governance, and performance diagnostics.

● Experience in at least 2 additional programmatic channels (e.g., Paid Social, YouTube, Display/Programmatic, Shopping/Feeds, etc.).

● Establish high standards for quality, speed, documentation, and accountability.

● Help build scalable processes that improve client outcomes and internal efficiency. Translate business goals into measurable media plans, including channel mix, budget allocation, forecasting, and pacing.

● Drive continuous improvement through testing: ad copy/creative tests, landing page/CRO collaboration, audience experiments, bid strategy tests, and offer positioning.

● Proven expertise in creating effective marketing strategies and reports

● Proven ability to lead teams and improve marketing performance

● Effective time management skills. Ability to multitask and manage multiple teams and projects

● Strong marketing copywriting skills is CRITICAL

● Proven ability to manage teams and budgets

● Professional and proactive work ethic

● High competence in project and stakeholder management

● Excellent interpersonal, communication skills

● Able to work EST hours work 8am to 5pm EST (with breaks)

● A work culture focused on mutual success and continuous growth

● Equity ownership in our company – share in profit upon company sale!

Experiência prévia em manutenção e evolução de sistemas já existentes
